Title: Test Epic - Batch Creation
Vision: Enable automated epic creation from structured data
Overview: Build batch epic creation capability for the create-epic skill
Current State: Currently epics are created one at a time through interactive mode
Desired State:
- Batch creation from CSV/Excel files
- Support for multiple epics in one operation
- Preview all epics before creation
Impact: Saves time for roadmap planning and reduces manual data entry
Success Criteria:
- Parse CSV files successfully
- Create multiple epics in one session
- Preserve all epic sections
User Value: Product managers can import epic roadmaps from spreadsheets
Strategic Alignment: Enables efficient roadmap planning and execution
